name: ISO 1101 geometrical characteristics and tolerance frame
source: ISO 1101:2017 Geometrical product specifications (GPS) - Geometrical tolerancing - Tolerances of form, orientation, location and run-out (fourth edition, confirmed, current); frame proportions from ISO 7083:1983
verifiedFrom: https://law.resource.org/pub/in/bis/S01/is.11158.1984.pdf (IS 11158:1984, identical with ISO 7083:1983: clause 5, Tables 1 and 2)
https://law.resource.org/pub/in/bis/S01/is.8000.1.1985.pdf (IS 8000 (Part 1):1985, identical with ISO 1101:1983: clause 8, datum indication)
characteristicsSource: ISO 1101:2017, clause 5, Table 2 'Symbols for geometrical characteristics' (characteristic, specification group, datum needed, subclause). datum: 'none' = 'no' in Table 2, 'required' = 'yes', 'optional' = 'no' in one row and 'yes' in another (position; line and surface profile, which have no datum as a form specification and a datum as orientation or location). symbol = MechPilot's Unicode mapping by Unicode character name (Miscellaneous Technical block); the drawn symbol follows the figure in Table 2. nameIt = MechPilot's own translation (UNI EN ISO 1101 Italian terms not seen).

characteristics.name: Line profile
characteristics.note: Datum 'no' as form, 'yes' as orientation or location. Called 'profile any line' in former versions (Table 2, NOTE 1).

characteristics.name: Surface profile
characteristics.note: Datum 'no' as form, 'yes' as orientation or location. Called 'profile any surface' in former versions (Table 2, NOTE 2).

characteristics.name: Circular run-out
characteristics.note: Unicode has no dedicated circular run-out character; the ISO symbol is a single filled arrow at about 45 degrees, drawn as a graphic.

frame.source: ISO 7083:1983, clause 5, Table 2 (lettering type B) and 5.2; ISO 1101:2017, clause 5 NOTE refers to ISO 7083 and its own Annex F (not seen) for proportions
frame.heightNote: Height of frame H = 2h for type B lettering (H 5, 7, 10, 14, 20, 28, 40 for h 2.5, 3.5, 5, 7, 10, 14, 20). Increase it when an additional tolerance value is inscribed in a lower compartment.
frame.lineWidthNote: Thickness of line d = h/10 for type B (0.25 to 2 mm in Table 2), the same as the lettering line width.
frame.firstCompartmentWidth: equal to H (holds the characteristic symbol)
frame.secondCompartmentWidth: to suit the length of the inscription (tolerance value and modifiers)
frame.furtherCompartments: to suit the width of the datum letter or letters
frame.minTextClearance: at least 2 d, minimum 0.7 mm, between the vertical strokes and the inscriptions

datumIndicator.form: a capital letter in a square frame, connected by a leader to a datum triangle; the triangle may be filled (solid) or open (blank)
datumIndicator.source: ISO 1101:1983, 8.1 (via IS 8000 (Part 1):1985); in ISO 1101:2017 datums are covered by ISO 5459, not seen
datumIndicator.proportions: ISO 7083:1983 Figures 16 and 17 (not transcribed; see docs/to-verify.md)

notes: Table 2 lists 15 rows; concentricity and coaxiality share one symbol, giving 14 distinct symbols.
Additional symbols (combined zone CZ, separate zones SZ, unequal zone UZ, projected zone P, MMR M, LMR L and others) are in ISO 1101:2017 Tables 3 and 4 and are not stored here yet.
